cancel_in_progress_false_allowlist.dependabot-auto-merge.yml: Dependabot auto-merge arms a single PR-specific merge path and should finish once started.
cancel_in_progress_false_allowlist.lockfile-upgrade.yml: The scheduled lockfile refresh is serialized maintenance that should finish once it has updated a branch.
cancel_in_progress_false_allowlist.release.yml: Release publishing must not be interrupted after versioning and tag orchestration begin.
cancel_in_progress_false_allowlist.verify-tag.yml: Tag verification should finish for the pushed release tag instead of being replaced mid-run.

pr_concurrency_singleton_allowlist.Agent-Redundant-PR-Closer.yml: Duplicate PR arbitration intentionally runs as one repo-wide singleton to compare all open PRs.
pr_concurrency_singleton_allowlist.Jules-Control-Tower.yml: The central orchestrator intentionally runs as one repo-wide singleton across PR and workflow_run triggers.
